docstring: Fisher-Weighted Singular Value Decomposition (FWSVD) Compressor.  Computes diagonal Fisher information matrix F_i = E[x_i^2] from calibration activations, weights the weight matrix W by diag(sqrt(F_i)), computes truncated SVD, and unweights factors by diag(1 / sqrt(F_i)). Uses the same structural SVDLinear replacement and fallback error logic as AA
